relationships.note: He names JD Vance in both the Watergate telling and the will-come-out telling in the same session, joining them himself.
He moves straight from the economy being a pig with lipstick to the new golden age and a new economic shift, presenting the collapse and the boom as one sequence.
Dying ministries that think they are alive is the same cleansing seen from inside a ministry. He does not state the link in these words.
Both place the coming trouble in Europe within the same session. No link asserted on air.
He frames the July word as one of the pieces he is releasing, holding the rest back.
